title: WeeklyCaseCount
description:
Newly reported cases in one MMWR week for one geography, under an explicit case definition.
(Cumulative-only sources are differenced by the connector; the row is always per week.)

cases.description:
The count (or its explicit absence). `reported` with `count: 0` is a real zero;
`missing` is unknown.

CaseCount.description:
A confirmed-case count that can be explicitly missing. `reported` with `count: 0` is a
real zero; `missing` is unknown. They are never interchangeable.

CaseDefinition.description:
Which cases a weekly count includes. A count is only comparable with counts that share its
definition, so every row states it. Add a variant (in a new contract version) for any other
source definition; never reuse `Confirmed` for a count that includes other case statuses.

oneOf.description:
Only cases whose case status is confirmed under the source's case definition, with no
other status mixed in.

Confirmed cases plus cases whose case status is unknown, without the two being told
apart. This is what CDC's NNDSS measles publication criteria publish (event code 10140:
case status "confirmed" and "unknown"); the weekly query has no case-status field to
split them, so these counts must not be presented as confirmed cases.

GeoId.description: Geography key: state FIPS (2 digits) or county FIPS (5 digits), zero-padded

MissingReason.description: Why a weekly count is missing.

oneOf.description: The source did not report this geography and week.
The source withheld the value (small-number suppression).
The source has the week but the value could not be read unambiguously.

MmwrWeek.description: An MMWR year and week number (`week` is `1..=52` or `1..=53`).

week.description: Week of the MMWR year; 1 to 52, or 53 in a 53-week year.

year.description: MMWR year (not always the calendar year of every day in the week).

Provenance.description: Where a number came from: the immutable snapshot, its source URL and when it was retrieved.

licence_id.description: Id of the source's licence or terms as listed in `SOURCES.md`.

sha256.description: Content address of the raw snapshot bytes.

source_id.description: Stable id of the source as listed in `SOURCES.md` (e.g. `cdc-measles-weekly`).

url.description: URL the snapshot was retrieved from.
